The brief fact relevant for disposal of this Rule is that the petitioner as pre-emptor filed Miscellaneous (Pre-emption) Case No. 72 of 2005 before the learned Assistant Judge, Satkania Chowki, Chattogram under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for pre-empting the case land as described in the schedule of the pre-emption application. 

 12. On scrutiny of the record, it appears that the petitioner as pre-emptor filed Miscellaneous (Pre-emption) Case No.72 of 2005 before the learned Assistant Judge, Satkania Chowki, Chattogram under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for pre-empting the case which was allowed on contest. Thereafter, the pre-emptee purchaser preferred Miscellaneous Appeal No. 183 of 2014 before the learned District Judge, Chattogram which was subsequently transmitted to the Court of the learned Additional District Judge, Dewlia Bishayak Adalat, Chattogram for disposal and during pendency of the appeal the pre-emptee-appellant-opposite party filed an application (Annexure-D) under Order 6, rule XVII of the Code of Civil Procedure for amendment of written objection introducing bundle of new facts (tall claim).
